criteria.criterion: `vloop run <brief>`, when the plan on disk is `state/v2` with status `complete` and its `brief` differs from the brief named, does not validate the plan: the preflight prints nothing for the `plan` check and the run goes on to the planner's `the plan <run id> was for <plan's brief> — you asked for <brief>: resetting and planning fresh`.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/doctor.go: `replaced` skips state.Check when runBrief is non-empty and differs from plan.Brief (runBriefPath gives repo-relative paths, same form as stored). cmd/vloop/run_iterate_test.go runs `vloop run otherPath` against a broken complete plan, expects exit 0 and 'resetting and planning fresh', and no plan problem line.

criteria.criterion: The bare `vloop doctor` does not validate a complete `state/v2` plan and prints `✓ plan a complete plan of <plan's brief> — the next brief's plan replaces it`, `<plan's brief>` the plan's `brief` field as stored; `vloop doctor --json` carries the same message with result `pass`.
criteria.evidence: doctor.go: runBrief == nil gives replaced and the pass message uses plan.Brief. run_iterate_test.go asserts the text line and the --json pass for the bare doctor.

criteria.criterion: Validated as at the base: a plan whose status is not `complete`; a complete plan when `vloop run` names no brief or names the plan's own brief (`  ✗ plan <n> problem(s) — run vloop task validate`, then `vloop: preflight failed — 1 problem(s), nothing has run`, exit 1, nothing run); both state/v1 cases; `vloop task validate`, which validates whatever plan is there. A complete plan of another brief validated, or a resumed plan not, is a violation.
criteria.evidence: The `replaced` condition requires schema state/v2 and status complete, and needs runBrief non-empty and different. The v1 cases and task validate are untouched. Tests cover run <own brief>, a bare run, and a running plan, all exit 1 with the preflight lines.

criteria.criterion: The existing callers of `runDoctor` and `runPreflight` (internal/cli/doctor_copilot_test.go, internal/cli/doctor_second_review_test.go) change only to pass the new parameter, with no brief, and keep every assertion; the work session names the contract item (V1) in its notes.
criteria.evidence: The diffs of both files change existing calls only (nil / ""); new tests are appended. The V1 mention is in the new test comments; proposal notes not checked, a minor point.

criteria.criterion: Committed tests run by the go check cover every V1 line of the worked example with stub sessions in a fixture repository, as cmd/vloop's run tests do — the bare doctor's pass (text and --json), `vloop run <b>` resetting and completing, `vloop run <a>` and a bare `vloop run` refused, and the planted running plan refused — plus the doctor's three cases in internal/cli.
criteria.evidence: TestRunCompletePlanOfAnotherBriefIsNotValidated in cmd/vloop/run_iterate_test.go covers each line; TestDoctorCompletePlanOfAnotherBrief in internal/cli/doctor_second_review_test.go covers nil, another brief, same, none and running. The go check exited 0.
